m.t: Teď už na tom stejně nezáleží, ne?

m.e: But it's hard to turn that into good news.

m.t: Špatná zpráva je, že tě tam vezmeme zpátky.
m.e: The bad news is we're bringing you back there.

m.t: Neřekla bych, že je to skvělá zpráva.
m.e: I wouldn't say it's great news.

m.t: A jak jsme viděli, pak se může stát cokoli.
m.e: And as we've seen, anything can happen from there.

m.t: No, vypadá to, že ať se mělo stát cokoli, nestalo se to.
m.e: Well, it seems that whatever was meant to happen hasn't come to pass.

m.t: Cokoli se s tebou děje, doufám, že se to vyřeší.
m.e: Whatever's going on with you, I hope you figure it out.

m.e: You can do whatever you want, you can live wherever you want.

m.e: I didn't intend to kill her, But before i say anything else, why do you already think that?
